t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said : Contentment is as good as estate, and goodness of moral character is as good as a blessing. Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, was asked about Allah's saying : (Whosoever did good, whether male or female, and he be a believer , then) ; We will certainly make him live a life good and pure (and certainly We will give them their return with the best of what they were doing), (Qur'an, 16:97)when he said : that means contentment.
